skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.name: Shield of the Scion
skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.description: Dealing magical damage with an ability grants the owner a small magical damage barrier. Effects stack, but their durations are independent.
skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.lore: The court mages of Skywrath may use their powers only to protect the kingdom and the throne.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.note0: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.shard_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.name: Concussive Shot
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note0: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note1: Damages creeps around the impact area.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note2: Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.scepter_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.note0: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.scepter_description: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.shard_description: Ancient Seal debuff now causes other debuffs applied to last 50%% longer. Grants vision over the target.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.name: Mystic Flare
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note0: Spell immune enemies do not count toward the damage distribution.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note1: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note2: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note3: Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.scepter_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
